:::{#def-estimated-overall-agreement}
#### Estimated overall agreement

The **estimated overall agreement** of an [agreement table](#def-agreement-table)
is the [sample proportion](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-proportion) of observations
on which the agent and the reference assign the same [class](#def-class),
which [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) $p_o$:

$$\Est{p}_o \eqdef \frac{a + d}{n}$$ {#eq-estimated-overall-agreement}

Source: @cohen1960coefficient.

:::
